1-2.objective: cybersecurity  programs  within the organization  as per related laws and regulations
1-2.full_text:
Cybersecurity  Management  
Objective   
 
cybersecurity  programs  within the organization  as per related laws and regulations  
Controls  
1-2-1 A dedicated  cybersecurity  function  (e.g., division,  department)  must be established 
within the organization.

1-2-1.full_text:
A dedicated  cybersecurity  function  (e.g., division,  department)  must be established 
within the organization.  This function  must be independent  from the Information 
Technology/Information  Communication  and Technology  (IT/ICT)  functions.

1-2-2.full_text:
The position  of cybersecurity  function  head (e.g., CISO), and related supervisory  and 
critical positions  within the function,  must be filled with full-time and experienced 
Saudi cybersecurity  professionals.

1-2-3.full_text:
A cybersecurity  steering  committee  must be established  by the Authorizing  Official  to 
ensure  the support  and implementation  of the cybersecurity  programs  and 
initiatives  within the organization.

1-3.objective:
To ensure that cybersecurity  requirements  are documented,  communicated  and 
complied  with by the organization.

1-3-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity  policies  and procedures  must be defined  and documented  by the 
cybersecurity  function,  approved  by the Authorizing  Official,  and disseminated  to 
relevant  parties inside and outside  the organization.

1-3-2.full_text:
The cybersecurity function must ensure that the cybersecurity policies and procedures 
are implemented.

1-3-3.full_text:
The cybersecurity  policies  and procedures  must be supported  by technical  security 
standards  (e.g., operating  systems,  databases  and firewall  technical  security 
standards).

1-3-4.full_text:
The cybersecurity  policies  and procedures  must be reviewed  periodically  according  to 
planned  intervals  or upon changes  to related  laws and regulations.

1-4.objective: To ensure that roles and responsibilities  are defined  for all parties.

1-4-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity  organizational  structure  and related roles and responsibilities  must be 
defined,  documented,  approved,  supported  and assigned  by the Authorizing  Official.

1-4-2.full_text: The cybersecurity  roles and responsibilities  must be reviewed  periodically.

1-5.objective: To ensure  managing  cybersecurity  risks in a methodological  approach.

1-5-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity  risk management  methodology  and procedures  must be defined, 
documented  and approved  as per confidentiality,  integrity  and availability 
considerations  of information  and technology  assets.

1-5-2.full_text:
The cybersecurity  risk management  methodology  and procedures  must be 
implemented by the cybersecurity function.

1-5-3.full_text:
The cybersecurity  risk assessment  procedures  must be implemented  at least in the 
following cases.

1-5-3-1.full_text:
Early stages of technology  projects.
Control  implementation  guidelines:
• Implement cybersecurity risk assessment procedures at early stages of technology projects to avoid events that could compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.

1-5-3-2.full_text:
Before making  major changes  to technology  infrastructure.
Control  implementation  guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Include cybersecurity requirements within the IT Change Management lifecycle
• Implement cybersecurity risk assessment procedures before making a material change in the technology architecture to avoid events or circumstances that could compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and technology assets.

1-5-3-3.full_text:
During the planning  phase of obtaining  third party services.
Control  implementation  guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Include cybersecurity requirements within the third-party, contracts, and procurement management procedures
• Implement cybersecurity risk assessment procedures when planning to acquire services from a third party.
Expected deliverables:
• A report that outlines the identification of cybersecurity risks for third party services.

1-5-3-4.full_text:
During the planning  phase and before going live for new technology services and products.
Control  implementation  guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Include cybersecurity requirements within the Release Management procedures
• Implement cybersecurity risk assessment procedures at the planning stage and before the release of new technology products and services.

1-5-4.full_text:
The cybersecurity  risk management  methodology  and procedures  must be reviewed 
periodically  according  to planned  intervals  or upon changes  to related  laws and 
regulations.

1-6.objective:
To ensure  that cybersecurity  requirements  are included  in project  management 
methodology  and procedures.
1-6.full_text: Cybersecurity  in Information  and Technology  Project Management

1-6-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity  requirements  must be included  in project  and asset (information/ 
technology)  change  management  methodology  and procedures  to identify  and 
manage  cybersecurity  risks as part of project management  lifecycle.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Include cybersecurity requirements in the project management methodology and procedures
• Assess and detect vulnerabilities before the deployment of services or systems online
• Ensure cybersecurity risks are identified and addressed in all technology projects.

1-6-2.full_text:
The cybersecurity  requirements  in project  and assets (information/technology) 
change  management  must include at least the following.

1-6-2-1.full_text:
Vulnerability  assessment  and remediation.
Control  implementation  guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this control in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Define systems, services, and technology components subject to Vulnerabilities Assessment within the scope of technical projects
• Develop and adopt procedures for the implementation of Vulnerabilities Assessment and remediation
• Conduct Vulnerabilities Assessment before launching technical projects in the production environment
• Conduct Vulnerabilities Assessment before the implementation of changes to the production environment.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Vulnerability assessment reports for technology projects and changes.

1-6-2-2.full_text:
Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before changes or going live for technology projects.
Relevant cybersecurity tools:
• Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Project Management and Changes to Information and Technology Assets.
• Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Application Development.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.

1-6-3.full_text:
The cybersecurity  requirements  related  to software  and application  development 
projects must include at least the following.

1-6-3-1.full_text:
Using secure coding standards.
Relevant cybersecurity tools:
• Secure Coding Standard Template.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Define and document technical cybersecurity requirements for Secure Coding Standard controls covering all phases of the secure coding process
• Ensure developers follow secure coding practices to protect software and applications against internal and external threats.
Expected deliverables:
• An approved secure coding standard document
• Evidence of applying secure coding standards in software development projects.

1-6-3-2.full_text:
Using trusted and licensed  sources  for software  development  tools and libraries.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Use only modern, reliable and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• An updated list of licensed and documented software used for application development tools and libraries.

1-6-3-3.full_text:
Conducting compliance test for software against the defined organizational cybersecurity requirements.
Relevant cybersecurity tools:
• Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Application Development.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Conduct testing to verify that applications meet the cybersecurity requirements of the organization, such as penetration testing
• Ensure that software compliance testing covers all defined organizational cybersecurity requirements before going live.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Software compliance testing reports against organizational cybersecurity requirements.

1-6-3-4.full_text:
Secure integration  between  software  components.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Ensure security of integration between applications by security testing of various integration technologies
• Perform System Integration Testing (SIT)
• Perform API testing.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• A report that outlines the testing and assessment of secure integration between applications.

1-6-3-5.full_text:
Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before going live for software products.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Review secure Configuration and Hardening and Patching before launching applications and ensure their implementation.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Configuration review and hardening reports for software products before go-live.

1-6-4.full_text:
The cybersecurity  requirements  in project  management  must be reviewed 
periodically.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Review the cybersecurity project management requirements periodically
• Document the review and changes to the cybersecurity requirements for project management.
Expected deliverables:
• An approved document that sets the review schedule
• Updated cybersecurity project management requirements approved by the head of the organization.

1-7.objective: To ensure compliance with cybersecurity laws and regulations.
1-7.full_text: Compliance  with Cybersecurity  Standard  controls,  Laws and Regulations

1-7-1.full_text:
The organization  must comply  with related  national  cybersecurity  laws and 
regulations.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Work with stakeholders to identify, document, and periodically update a list of national cybersecurity laws and regulations
• Ensure compliance with all national cybersecurity laws and regulations requirements
• Provide necessary technologies to verify compliance with national cybersecurity laws.

1-7-2.full_text:
The organization  must comply with any nationally-approved  international  
agreements  and commitments  related to cybersecurity.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Work with the organization's stakeholders to identify, document, approve and periodically update the list of international cybersecurity agreements
• Ensure compliance with all cybersecurity national laws and regulations requirements approved by the National Cybersecurity Authority.

1-8-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity  reviews  must be conducted  periodically  by the cybersecurity  function to 
assess the compliance  with the cybersecurity  controls  in the organization.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Review the implementation of cybersecurity requirements at the organization periodically
• Ensure that the cybersecurity controls are effectively implemented and operate in accordance with regulatory policies.

1-8-2.full_text:
Cybersecurity  audits and reviews  must be conducted  by independent  parties outside 
the cybersecurity  function  to assess  the compliance with the cybersecurity  controls.

1-8-3.full_text:
Results  from the cybersecurity  audits and reviews  must be documented  and presented 
to the cybersecurity  steering  committee  and Authorizing  Official.

1-9.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity  risks and requirements  related to personnel are managed.

1-9-1.full_text:
Personnel cybersecurity requirements (prior to employment, during employment and  
after termination/separation)  must be defined,  documented  and approved.

1-9-2.full_text:
The personnel  cybersecurity  requirements  must be implemented.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Implement all personnel-related cybersecurity requirements
• Develop an action plan to implement cybersecurity requirements related to personnel
• Include personnel cybersecurity requirements in the organization's HR procedures.

1-9-3.full_text:
The personnel  cybersecurity  requirements  prior to employment  must include at least 
the following.

1-9-3-1.full_text:
Inclusion of personnel cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses in employment contracts.
Relevant cybersecurity tools:
• Acknowledgment and confidentiality templates.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Work with relevant departments to include cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses in the contracts of employees
• Include such requirements in the organization's HR procedures.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Employment contracts containing cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses.

1-9-3-2.full_text:
Screening or vetting candidates of cybersecurity and critical/privileged positions.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Work with relevant departments to ensure Screening or Vetting of all employees in cybersecurity functions.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Evidence of screening or vetting for cybersecurity and critical positions.

1-9-4.full_text:
The personnel  cybersecurity  requirements  during employment  must include at least 
the following.

1-9-4-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity awareness (during on-boarding and during employment).
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Work with relevant departments to provide cybersecurity awareness at the beginning and during work
• Include such requirements in the organization's HR procedures.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Evidence of cybersecurity awareness programs provided to employees.

1-9-4-2.full_text:
Implementation of and compliance with the cybersecurity requirements as per the organizational cybersecurity policies and procedures.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Inform all employees of the organization and obtain their approval on the cybersecurity policies and procedures
• Include personnel cybersecurity requirements in the organization's HR procedures.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• An acknowledgment form for approving cybersecurity policies signed by employees.

1-9-5.full_text:
Personnel  access  to information  and technology  assets  must be reviewed  and removed 
immediately upon  termination/separation.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Review access of employees and revoke it immediately after the end/termination of their professional service.

1-9-6.full_text:
Personnel  cybersecurity  requirements  must be reviewed  periodically.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Review and update the cybersecurity policy and requirements for personnel periodically
• Document the review and changes to the cybersecurity requirements for personnel.

1-10-1.full_text:
A cybersecurity  awareness  program  must be developed  and approved.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Develop and approve cybersecurity awareness program and plan in the organization through multiple channels periodically
• Include awareness emails, cybersecurity awareness workshops, distribution of awareness publications.

1-10-2.full_text: The cybersecurity  awareness  program  must be implemented.

1-10-3.full_text: The cybersecurity  awareness  program  must cover the latest cyber threats and must include at least the following subjects.

1-10-3-1.full_text:
Secure handling of email services, especially phishing emails.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Provide cybersecurity awareness programs that cover the safe handling of e-mail services, especially with emails and social engineering.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• Evidence of providing awareness content for the safe handling of e-mail services.

1-10-3-2.full_text:
Secure handling of mobile devices and storage media.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Provide cybersecurity awareness programs that cover the safe handling of mobile devices and storage media.

1-10-3-3.full_text:
Secure Internet browsing.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Provide cybersecurity awareness programs that cover the safe handling of internet browsing services.
Expected deliverables:
• Evidence that awareness content is provided for the secure handling of internet browsing services.

1-10-3-4.full_text:
Secure use of social media.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Provide cybersecurity awareness programs that cover the safe handling of social media.

1-10-4.full_text: Essential and customized training and access to professional skillsets must be made available to personnel working directly on tasks related to cybersecurity.

1-10-4-1.full_text:
Cybersecurity function personnel training.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Develop and implement an approved cybersecurity training plan for employees of the cybersecurity function
• Assist in the establishment of cybersecurity career paths to allow career progression.
Expected deliverables:
• A document indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control
• An approved cybersecurity training plan for cybersecurity function personnel.

1-10-4-2.full_text:
Personnel working on software/application development and information and technology assets operations.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Develop and implement an approved cybersecurity training plan for personnel working on software development and IT operations.

1-10-4-3.full_text:
Executive and supervisory positions.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document
• Develop and implement an approved cybersecurity training plan for employees of the cybersecurity Supervisory and executive functions.

1-10-5.full_text:
The implementation  of the cybersecurity  awareness  program  must be reviewed 
periodically.
Control implementation guidelines:
• Review the cybersecurity requirements of cybersecurity awareness and training programs by conducting a periodic assessment
• Conduct application review through traditional channels or automated channels using a compliance management system.
